s1.desc: a living room drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.view: with a long cream sofa with yellow shell-shaped armrests

beats.text: Polly sits on the sofa looking down at {ifin} in her flippers while Pax beside her looks down at his own phone
Polly turns her head to look at Pax, holding her phone at her chest, while he keeps looking down at his phone
Pax lowers his phone to his lap and turns his wide eyes toward Polly while she keeps looking at him

spans.notes: camera locked (motion on the sofa-base band y0.66-0.80: scale 1.0000, <=0.5 px, cc 1.000 f6-48; frame-to-frame diff on that band and on the left armrest 0.00-0.01 every frame). Both phones are iFins (pale grey backs, lenses, tuft on top); only their backs face the viewer, so no screen content is visible in this shot. Hard cut at f49. No overlay

Pax alone at the end of the sofa scrolling a chat on the iFin, screen facing the viewer the whole shot: a Polly avatar in the chat header and shared clips of Polly (in a bubble f52-60, at a table f96-108, more after) are visible throughout. Also a steady slow push-in for the whole shot (sofa band scale 1.011 at f57 -> 1.087 at f113, cc >= 0.94; frame diff ~0.5 every frame f50-142). Skit ends on this shot
